BarberShop.title: BarberShop
BarberShop.description: Represents a barber shop within the SaaS application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the barber shop.

ownerId.description: Reference to the User who owns the barber shop. (Relationship: User 1:N BarberShop)

phone.description: Phone number of the barber shop.

email.description: Email address of the barber shop.

workingHours.description: Working hours for each day of the week.

subscription.description: Subscription details for the barber shop.

whatsapp.description: Credentials for the Evolution API WhatsApp agent.

Appointment.title: Appointment
Appointment.description: Represents an appointment scheduled at a barber shop.

barberShopId.description: Reference to the BarberShop where the appointment is scheduled. (Relationship: BarberShop 1:N Appointment)

customerId.description: Reference to the Customer who scheduled the appointment. (Relationship: Customer 1:N Appointment)

barberId.description: Reference to the Barber assigned to the appointment. (Relationship: Barber 1:N Appointment)

serviceIds.description: References to Services provided during the appointment. (Relationship: Service N:N Appointment)

status.description: The current status of the appointment.

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: Represents a customer of a barber shop.

barberShopId.description: Reference to the BarberShop the customer belongs to. (Relationship: BarberShop 1:N Customer)

cep.description: Postal code (CEP) for the customer's address.

Barber.title: Barber
Barber.description: Represents a barber working at a barber shop.

barberShopId.description: Reference to the BarberShop the barber belongs to. (Relationship: BarberShop 1:N Barber)

bio.description: A brief biography of the barber.

avatar.description: URL for the barber's profile picture.

Service.title: Service
Service.description: Represents a service offered by a barber shop.

barberShopId.description: Reference to the BarberShop that offers the service. (Relationship: BarberShop 1:N Service)

cost.description: Cost of the service for the business.

duration.description: Duration of the service in minutes.

partnership.description: Partnership and commission settings for the service.

isCommissionEnabled.description: Indicates if a commission is enabled for this service.

commissionType.description: The type of commission (fixed amount or percentage).

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product for sale at the barber shop.

FinancialRecord.title: FinancialRecord
FinancialRecord.description: Represents a financial record for a barber shop, including income and expenses.

id.description: Unique identifier for the financial record.

barberShopId.description: Reference to the BarberShop the record belongs to. (Relationship: BarberShop 1:N FinancialRecord)

amount.description: The monetary value of the transaction.

category.description: Category of the income (e.g., 'Venda de Serviço', 'Venda de Produto') or expense (e.g., 'Aluguel', 'Fornecedores').

paymentMethod.description: Method of payment for an income record (e.g., 'Dinheiro', 'Cartão de Crédito', 'Pix'). Only applicable if type is 'income'.

isRecurring.description: Indicates if an expense is recurring (e.g., monthly rent). Only applicable if type is 'expense'.

Supplier.title: Supplier
Supplier.description: Represents a supplier or vendor for a barber shop.

barberShopId.description: Reference to the BarberShop the supplier belongs to.

contactPerson.description: Name of the primary contact person.

phone.description: Contact phone number for the supplier.

category.description: Category of products/services provided (e.g., 'Produtos de Cabelo', 'Equipamentos').

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the SaaS application.  Note: Authentication details (passwords, etc.) should be managed by Firebase Authentication and are NOT included here.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user.  This is the Firebase UID.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Represents an administrator user. The document ID is the user's UID.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the admin was added.

Ticket.title: Ticket
Ticket.description: Represents a support ticket submitted by a user.

shopId.description: Reference to the BarberShop that created the ticket.

userId.description: Reference to the User who created the ticket.

subject.description: The subject of the support ticket.

description.description: The detailed description of the issue.

status.description: The current status of the ticket.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the ticket was created.

lastUpdatedAt.description: The timestamp of the last update to the ticket.

Document.title: Document
Document.description: Represents legal documents like Terms of Service.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support a multi-tenant barber shop SaaS application, focusing on data isolation and secure access.  Each barber shop's data is segregated under a collection named 'barberShops', enabling clear separation and targeted security rules. User data is stored under the 'users' collection, with each user document containing their profile information. Barber shops owned by a user are linked via the 'ownerId' field in the barberShops documents. The structure prioritizes authorization independence through path-based ownership and denormalization. Specifically, collections nested under `/barberShops/{barberShopId}` denormalize the `barberShopId` which is required for QAPs (secure list operations).  This removes the need for `get()` calls in security rules and enables atomic operations.

The key collections and their relationships are structured as follows:

*   `/users/{userId}`: Stores user profiles. This collection uses path-based ownership.
*   `/barberShops/{barberShopId}`: Stores barber shop data.  The `ownerId` field links back to the user who owns the shop. 
*   `/barberShops/{barberShopId}/products/{productId}`: Stores product data.
*   `/barberShops/{barberShopId}/customers/{customerId}`: Stores customer data for a specific barber shop. The `barberShopId` is implicitly denormalized by the path.
*   `/barberShops/{barberShopId}/barbers/{barberId}`: Stores barber data for a specific barber shop. The `barberShopId` is implicitly denormalized by the path.
*   `/barberShops/{barberShopId}/appointments/{appointmentId}`: Stores appointment data for a specific barber shop. The `barberShopId` is implicitly denormalized by the path.
*   `/barberShops/{barberShopId}/services/{serviceId}`: Stores service data for a specific barber shop. The `barberShopId` is implicitly denormalized by the path.
*   `/barberShops/{barberShopId}/suppliers/{supplierId}`: Stores supplier data for a specific barber shop.
*   `/barberShops/{barberShopId}/financialRecords/{financialRecordId}`: Stores financial records for a specific barber shop. The `barberShopId` is implicitly denormalized by the path.

This design supports the core features of the application, including multi-tenant dashboards, real-time metrics, appointment scheduling, client management, and financial tracking, while maintaining a secure and scalable data structure.
